prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Actinium (Ac) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a chemistry laboratory with a long worktable of glass flasks, a fume hood and shelves of labelled reagent bottles
Weather / season: a misty morning — soft fog outside.
Time of day: dawn — the first pale light, cool and quiet, the sky just turning; the first pale light at the window, the room still dim.
Hair: her hair let down loose over her shoulders — same colour and length as the attached image.
Small moment: a light smudge of flour marks her cheek.
Outfit: a tight tube top under an open cropped cardigan with glossy high-waisted leggings that outline the hips and legs — in dark burgundy; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: seated on a chair.
SUPPORT: her back rests against the seat back.
COMPOSITION: a close-up of her face and hair; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; camera at her eye level.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a small dark glass vial glowing faint blue from within, set in a silver ray-shaped holder up beside her face; it is all she holds.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: soft distant eyes, faint wistful half-smile, brows gently raised at the inner ends.

Framing: a close-up — her face and hair fill most of the frame and the bottom edge crosses at her collarbones; nothing below the shoulders shows, and her hands and anything she holds stay below the frame unless raised to her face.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — actinium: a soft silvery-white metal named from the Greek for a ray or beam, found in 1899 in the residues of pitchblende ore and again in 1902 by a chemist at a quinine works; its own radiation wakes the surrounding air so that it glows a pale blue in the dark, and gram for gram it is some hundred and fifty times more radioactive than radium; the fifteen elements from actinium to lawrencium, uranium and plutonium among them, are called the actinides after it; born from protactinium, it now and then gives rise to francium, and one short-lived form is being made into an alpha-ray medicine that strikes only cancer cells — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: keep her exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
